description: Defines the HpackDecoderStringBuffer class used in HPACK decoding within HTTP/2, managing string buffers for header name/value literals, including Huffman decoding support.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStringBuffer
classes.description: Manages string buffers for HPACK header fields, supporting Huffman decoding, buffering, and state management.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Initializes the buffer with a string view and static flag.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Begins processing a string, indicating Huffman encoding and length.

methods.name: BufferStringIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Buffers the string if not already buffered.

methods.name: IsBuffered
methods.description: Checks if the string is buffered.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string view of the collected string.

methods.name: GetStringIfComplete
methods.description: Returns the string if collection is complete.

methods.name: ReleaseString
methods.description: Returns the collected string by value and resets the buffer.

methods.name: backing_for_testing
methods.description: Returns backing storage type for testing.

methods.name: OutputDebugStringTo
methods.description: Outputs debug info to a stream.
